changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW data.v_curr_state AS SELECT 'wallet_balance'::text AS metric, wb.ts_db AS last_date_time, round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - to_timestamp(wb.ts_bybit::double precision / 1000.0::double precision))) < 10::numeric AS is_actual FROM data.wallet_balance wb WHERE wb.id = (( SELECT max(wbi.id) AS max FROM data.wallet_balance wbi)) UNION ALL SELECT 'candle_kline_'::text || s.code::text AS metric, NULL::timestamp without time zone AS last_date_time, CASE WHEN sum(1) = sum( CASE WHEN dse.is_actual THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN true ELSE false END AS is_actual FROM ( SELECT ds.id_symbol, ds.c_interval, ds.max_start_ts, round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - to_timestamp(ds.max_start_ts::double precision / 1000.0::double precision))) AS diff_seconds, CASE WHEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - to_timestamp(ds.max_start_ts::double precision / 1000.0::double precision))) <= (ds.c_interval::integer * 60)::numeric THEN true ELSE false END AS is_actual FROM ( SELECT ci.id_symbol, ci.c_interval, max(k.start_ts) AS max_start_ts FROM data.candle ci JOIN data.kline k ON k.id_candle = ci.id WHERE ci.start_ts IS NULL GROUP BY ci.id_symbol, ci.c_interval) ds) dse JOIN data.symbol s ON s.id = dse.id_symbol GROUP BY s.code ORDER BY 1 DESC;
